name: Transmission
description: TREMEC TR-6060 six-speed manual (ZL1 1LE RPO MH3) with its seals, plugs, vent, solenoids, switches and sensors; race alternatives include TREMEC Magnum XL and sequential dog boxes (Holinger RD6, Xtrac, Samsonas).

components.name: Transmission (TREMEC TR-6060 / race gearbox)
components.description: Six-speed manual gearbox behind the bellhousing. The factory Gen 6 manual is the TREMEC 6060 (TR-6060): aluminum case, triple-cone synchros on 1st/2nd, double-cone on 3rd-6th and reverse, tapered roller bearings on main and countershaft, internal shift rails with an external shift rod to a rearward-mounted shifter, solenoid 2nd/3rd inhibit (skip-shift) and reverse inhibit; rated 650 lb-ft (881 N·m) input. Race alternatives are a TREMEC Magnum XL (stronger H-pattern), a dog-ring conversion, or a sequential dog box (Holinger RD6, Xtrac as on the Camaro GT4.R, Samsonas).
components.location: In the transmission tunnel from bellhousing (x≈0.56) to output flange (x≈1.25), centerline y≈0.36-0.40, z=0.

factory.name: TREMEC 6060 6-speed manual, RPO MH3 (ZL1 1LE)
factory.notes: MH3 ratios (GM bulletin 17-NA-251): 1st 2.29, 2nd 1.61, 3rd 1.21, 4th 1.00, 5th 0.82, 6th 0.68, Rev 3.11; trans temperature sensor warns above 325°F (163°C); standard trans cooler on ZL1 1LE. 2016+ Camaro SS TR-6060 ratios: 2.66/1.78/1.30/1.00/0.74/0.50, Rev 2.90 (Wikipedia table). Final drive 3.73 with manual (ZL1).

raceOptions.name: TREMEC Magnum XL (GM) close-ratio
raceOptions.notes: 700 lb-ft, 7,800 rpm, 26-spline input / 31-spline output, 150 lb dry, 3.66 qt; TUET18131 = 2.66/1.78/1.30/1.00/0.80/0.63 R2.90 (2010-15 ZL1 ratios). Requires adapting mount/shifter/driveshaft for Gen 6 (kits exist for 5th-gen).

raceOptions.name: Holinger RD6-S 6-speed sequential
raceOptions.notes: Dog-change sequential for front-engine RWD race cars; 880 N·m (650 lb-ft) endurance rating, 39 kg (86 lb), internal oil pump + paper/magnetic filter + spray bar with external cooler provision, gear-position sensor supplied, removable quill input, fixed flange or slip-yoke output, ≈1.8 L gear oil (85W-140 or 75W-90 GL-5 synthetic LSD oil). Needs custom LT bellhousing/quill, crossmember and driveshaft.

raceOptions.name: Xtrac 6-speed sequential (Camaro GT4.R)
raceOptions.notes: Factory-backed GT4.R used an Xtrac six-speed sequential with pneumatic paddle shift and an Xtrac LSD; available through Chevrolet/Pratt Miller customer racing channels.

raceOptions.name: Samsonas 6-speed sequential
raceOptions.notes: Up to ~1,400 N·m depending on spec, ≈38 kg; custom LT bellhousing, mount and driveshaft required (listing is for other platforms).

fluids.name: Manual transmission fluid (TR-6060)
fluids.spec: GM: 'see dealer' (owner manual); GM 88861800 Manual Transmission & Transfer Case Fluid commonly cited for TR-6060 (Dexron III-type ATF). TREMEC-approved: TREMEC HP-MTF, Synchromesh, Dexron III ATF. Avoid thin Dexron VI.
fluids.capacity: ≈3.5 L / 3.66 qt (TREMEC Magnum XL listing; TR-6060 similar) - fill to bottom of fill-plug hole. Change every 15 h of track use (GM).

fluids.name: Sequential gearbox oil (Holinger RD6-S)
fluids.spec: Fully synthetic GL-5 LSD gear oil, 85W-140 (75W-90 acceptable)

hardware.notes: Slip-yoke version: 80 ft-lb (110 N·m). Layshaft nut (LH thread) 80 ft-lb (110 N·m).

hardware.item: Holinger RD6-S front cover bolts / M8 nuts (set)
hardware.notes: M6 capscrews 12 ft-lb (16 N·m); M5 capscrews 7 ft-lb (9.5 N·m); detent plunger cap 15 ft-lb (20 N·m).

installNotes: Fill with fluid before installation (easier on the bench) - or plan access to the fill plug in the car.
Install HRB, bleeder line and internal clutch hose on the trans before mating.
Support trans on a transmission jack at its installed angle; align input splines with clutch by rotating output in gear; slide fully home without forcing - never draw it in with bolts.
Install crossmember/mount, then output flange/driveshaft, shift rod, sensors and cooler lines.
Set trans/crank angle to match pinion angle for the driveshaft (see driveshaft notes).
inspection: Fluid level & condition every event; change every 15 h track (GM)
Leaks at output seal / front seal
Synchro grind or jumping out of gear

components.name: Transmission output flange
components.description: Splined flange on the trans mainshaft to which the front driveshaft coupler (factory flex disc) or a CV flange adapter (aftermarket one-piece shafts) bolts. Its pilot centers the driveshaft.

factory.name: GM TR-6060 output flange
factory.notes: 3-bolt coupler pattern on factory two-piece shaft.

raceOptions.name: Gearbox-specific flange/yoke
raceOptions.notes: Sequential boxes offer fixed flange or slip yoke output.

hardware.torque: 100 ft-lb (136 N·m) (OEM MM6 propshaft transmission yoke/flange nut)
hardware.notes: Not normally removed except for output seal replacement - mark flange/shaft position. Holinger fixed-flange equivalent is 150 ft-lb (205 N·m). Checked 2026-10: the TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists 'Propshaft transmission yoke nut (MM6)' at 136 N·m (100 lb ft). GM bulletin 20-NA-153 (2020 Camaro M13) uses a new nut and thrust washer at 145 N·m (107 lb ft) (https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2020/MC-10180313-9999.pdf); low torque there let the speed-sensor reluctor slip. Use a new nut.

installNotes: Clean pilot and face before fitting coupler/adapter.

components.name: Transmission rear output seal
components.description: Lip seal around the output flange hub that keeps fluid in the tailhousing. A common leak point after driveshaft vibration or flange removal.
installNotes: Drive in square with a seal driver; lube lip with trans fluid.

components.description: Seal in the front bearing retainer around the input shaft. A leak here contaminates the clutch; replace whenever the HRB/CSC is off.
components.location: Front of transmission case inside the bellhousing (x≈0.55).
installNotes: Replace with every clutch job; lube lip.

components.name: Fill and drain plugs (magnetic drain)
components.description: Side fill/level plug and bottom magnetic drain plug. Fill to the bottom of the fill hole on a level car. The magnetic drain is your best window into gearbox health - photograph debris each change.
components.location: Fill: side of case (passenger side, x≈0.86, y≈0.38). Drain: bottom of case (x≈0.80, y≈0.26).

factory.name: TREMEC fill and drain plugs
factory.notes: Holinger RD6 fill plug is on the LH side and doubles as level check.

raceOptions.name: Drain/fill plug with -AN cooler port adapters
raceOptions.notes: When an external cooler is used on the TR-6060 the pickup/return are often taken from these ports (see coolers).

hardware.threadlocker: Thread sealant if tapered pipe thread
hardware.notes: Estimate - confirm TREMEC value. Holinger RD6 drain/fill: 60 ft-lb (80 N·m). Checked 2026-10: the TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists 'Transmission case drain plug (MM6)' at 27 N·m (20 lb ft). CORRECTED from a 25 ft-lb estimate. The Holinger value applies only to Holinger cases.
Checked 2026-10: the TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists 'Transmission case fill plug (MM6)' at 27 N·m (20 lb ft). CORRECTED from a 25 ft-lb estimate.

installNotes: Always crack the FILL plug loose before draining.
Lockwire drain/fill plugs if class rules require (common for race gearboxes).

components.name: Transmission vent / breather
components.description: Breather that relieves case pressure as fluid heats. On a race car extend it with a hose up to a high point (or a small catch can) so hot fluid is not sprayed onto the exhaust under hard cornering.
components.location: Top of case (x≈0.95, y≈0.52), hose routed up the tunnel.

factory.name: TREMEC vent (cap or barb)
factory.notes: Magnum XL feature list includes a vent tube.

raceOptions.name: Extended vent hose to catch bottle
raceOptions.notes: Rules often require catch tanks for gearbox/diff breathers.

installNotes: Route hose upward, no low sag; protect from exhaust.

components.name: Skip-shift (2nd/3rd inhibit) solenoid
components.description: Factory solenoid that blocks 2nd and 3rd from 1st at light throttle (forcing 1-4) for fuel economy. Unwanted on a race car; disable with the ECU calibration or an eliminator plug/block-off (do not leave the solenoid connected without its control).
components.location: On the shifter rail housing on top/side of the case (x≈0.90, y≈0.50, z≈+0.08).

factory.name: TR-6060 2nd/3rd inhibit solenoid
factory.notes: Listed in GM MH3 description as 'Solenoid inhibit of SECOND and THIRD gears'.

raceOptions.name: Skip-shift eliminator / ECU disable
raceOptions.notes: Disable in calibration first; eliminator plug if solenoid removed.

installNotes: If removed, install proper block-off to keep fluid in and rail positioning correct.

components.name: Reverse inhibit / lockout solenoid
components.description: Solenoid that blocks reverse when the car is moving forward above a calibrated speed. Keep it functional (powered by ECM or a simple speed-switched relay) - a missed 6th-to-reverse on track destroys the gearbox. Sequential boxes use a mechanical reverse lockout on the lever.
components.location: Shift rail housing on the case (x≈0.92, y≈0.50, z≈-0.08).

factory.name: TR-6060 reverse inhibit solenoid
factory.notes: 'Solenoid inhibit of REVERSE gear during predefined forward motion' (GM).

raceOptions.name: Mechanical reverse lockout (sequential lever)
raceOptions.notes: Reverse requires a pull-up/trigger at the lever.

installNotes: Verify reverse is blocked above walking speed during shakedown.
